title: mimid-chat: a JMAP mode against a mimid server (Room/create, KeyPackage/set, KeyMaterial/fetch)
description: Client-side steps from mimid-1wgh.12.4's design draft (steps 5-7), split off when the server side of Room/create landed 2026-11-15: mimid-seed --issue-token; mimid-chat --mimid mode that publishes KeyPackages with KeyPackage/set, builds the group (external sender = hubSender, franking_agent, Safe AAD requiring frank_aad, roles_list, base_room_policy, participant_list=[me], room_metadata with a roomIdPrefix + base32(16 random octets) room ID, 16-octet random group ID) and calls Room/create, fetches others' KeyPackages with KeyMaterial/fetch, and reads Chat/get + Message/query/get. Room/update, Room/send (.12.6, .12.7) are needed for invite and send over JMAP. Then a live script against mimid.reviewcommit.com with a Haven user.
notes: 2026-11-15 slice 1 done: JMAP transport, /host via Room/create, publish/invite/send over JMAP; tried locally (alice hosts, sends, invites bob). Next slice: receive over JMAP (poll Message/changes or EventSource; Messages are base64url FanoutMessages: Welcome -> join, Commit/Proposal/application -> process). Token/account via mimid admin (no seed change needed).
